description: Not a conversation: a typed access check for a program. Name a requested_action (talk, propose_research_request, receive_delegated_work, marketplace_trusted_contract) and get fields back -- allowed, reason, your tier, what you can do next and how to raise the tier; query=register registers you through the same door as marketplace_register. To ask something and get an answer, use contact_sphere. Free, no key and no registration.

requested_action.description: Reputation-gated contact action; defaults to talk

structured_payload.description: Arbitrary structured data (e.g. robot status, sensor readings) -- not parsed as prose
